title: Lachit Borphukan
desc: Visual treatment, animated panels and custom maps for Prachyam.
lead: I led the visual treatment and motion design for Prachyam’s film on Lachit Borphukan, working within a twelve-day schedule.
body: Prachyam’s film follows Lachit Borphukan, an Ahom commander associated with the Battle of Saraighat. My work covered the visual treatment and motion design for its panels.
detail: I used Midjourney and Photoshop’s generative fill for most panels, and designed the maps myself. The project ran for twelve days.
contribution: Led the visual treatment and motion design for the panels.
Created AI-assisted imagery and custom map panels.

story.challenge: Prachyam’s film follows Lachit Borphukan, the Ahom commander associated with the Battle of Saraighat. I had twelve days to develop the visual treatment and motion design for my part of the film.
story.ownership: As Creative Lead and Art Director at Prachyam, I owned the visual treatment and execution as the sole contributor, including compositing and custom maps.
decisions: Use Midjourney and Photoshop’s generative fill to create most panels.
I designed custom map panels to make the geography easier to follow.
Carry the visual treatment through each panel’s motion design.
story.result: The completed work is documented in my film showreel and selected frames.

summary: I led the visual treatment and motion design for Prachyam’s film on Lachit Borphukan, working within a twelve-day schedule.
